reviewed_interfaces.MODEL: Q01 four-only nonlinear grid likelihood region with triangle/box remainder envelope; local Fisher scale/condition diagnostic, no interior derivative requirement. V01 correlated Schur-complement prediction over frozen four-only region; witness never changes estimate. Explicitly nominal.
reviewed_interfaces.WRITER: UTF-8 live case/batch/active byte limits and reserved outcomes checked; execute_task catches quota failure and attempts actual return, without further events.
reviewed_interfaces.PLANNER: 64 finite candidates, qualified positions separated from attempts; truth-free position/stage proposal followed by actual navigation/return/distinctness gates.
reviewed_interfaces.STATE: New region mode passes fixed-input 4+1, boundary, bad geometry, invalid covariance, 100 m corrupt heldout, raw-member exclusion, frozen estimate and navigation-version checks.
reviewed_interfaces.RECORDING: Only recording branches change in MotionWorld compact mode; no physics/navigation/radio arithmetic is skipped.
reviewed_interfaces.OFFLINE: Only after MotionWorld.finish: store terminal true coordinates and physical home/final pose, allowing direct external error reconstruction. No decision inputs change.
reviewed_interfaces.RETURN_EXECUTION: Per-reference-step movement/image deadline reserves conditional return; actual posterior return is rechecked. Insufficient service budget terminates work rather than consuming return time. Deterministic positive-neighbor and no-motion-on-no-budget checks pass.
reviewed_interfaces.SHARED_POINT: At an occupied point, actual onsite image plus radio/retreat/return gates are reused between IDs. Post-service image and stop occur onsite; failure recovery does not create a fictitious posterior. No model/numeric-parameter changes.
reviewed_interfaces.STAGE_ADMISSION: Partial-position bookkeeping uses existing 0.05 s decision budget; four-fit/heldout uses existing 8 s. Only VERIFY can publish and reserves STOP. If onsite compute/retreat cannot be reserved, actually recenter and rebuild the same 4+1 inputs at the new common navigation version; notification may return to the known service point, without new RTT. Every segment/STOP preserves return.
reviewed_interfaces.COORDINATION: P02: compare all current proposals with VERIFY priority; allow at most two fit-supplement plans during coverage, at most one supplement between coverage vertices; LOCALIZE puts geometry gain before nominal range risk. Same candidates/quotas apply to cost comparator.
reviewed_interfaces.TRANSACTION: Choose 2..4 complete atomic recovery blocks from actual remaining time, phase computation/STOP cost and conditional return reserve; NOTICE has no cold macro. Already-paid wait is not counted twice. Recheck actual image/navigation/return per atomic block; only four complete cold services form a macro.
